description: This file contains API service functions for managing wireless network configurations, including fetching and updating WLAN settings such as basic info, advanced settings, WPS, and mesh network configurations. It also includes mock data handling for development environment.

methods.name: getWlanBasic
methods.description: Fetches basic WLAN configuration data, returns mock data in development mode.

methods.name: updateWlanBasic
methods.description: Updates basic WLAN configuration data via POST request.

methods.name: getWlanAdvanced
methods.description: Fetches advanced WLAN settings, returns mock data in development mode.

methods.name: updateWlanAdvanced
methods.description: Updates advanced WLAN settings, with data transformation in development mode.

methods.name: getWlanWps
methods.description: Fetches WLAN WPS configuration, returns mock data in development mode.

methods.name: updateWlanWps
methods.description: Updates WLAN WPS configuration via POST request.

methods.name: getWlanMesh
methods.description: Fetches WLAN mesh network configuration, returns mock data in development mode.

methods.name: updateWlanMesh
methods.description: Updates WLAN mesh network configuration via POST request.
